title: Cline's Hub Process Reached Tens of Gigabytes
caption:
Turns out "just restart it" was load-bearing advice.

Cline's background Hub process broadcast a full copy of the conversation transcript to every connected client on every session status update. On a long task that's megabytes per change, and the process could grow to tens of gigabytes.

4.1.17 makes snapshots carry state only. Honest fix, and the kind of bug I'd never have found on my own.

How long is your longest session?

slides.headline:
One Chat.
Tens Of Gigabytes.
slides.sub: Cline's background Hub process ballooned in memory during long sessions.

slides.title: The Whole Transcript
slides.sub: Session status updates broadcast a full copy of the conversation to every connected client. Each change shipped megabytes.

slides.headline:
Fixed In
Cline 4.1.17
slides.sub: Snapshots now carry state only. If you run long sessions on the SDK bundle, upgrade — a restart only buys you the next long task.
